description: Saves a one-time NFTm page where the creator approves two transactions in Phantom: the collection, then the mint setup. Requires confirm: true. A quote over 10 SOL also requires confirmHighValue: true. This tool does not upload, sign, or create a store, and it does not accept a private key or an art folder id.

bytesBase64.description: Raw image bytes as base64. Optional when sizeBytes alone is enough for a quote.

sizeBytes.description: Size in bytes. Required when bytesBase64 is omitted.

url.description: https URL of the image. Optional.

name: nftm_launch_collection
title: Launch an NFTm collection
